narrative.headline: A bold attempt to replace the PLC that needs a plant pilot and certification before investors will follow.
narrative.general_summary: Neuron Industries is a two person Summer 2026 company building an industrial controller designed for AI, aimed at replacing PLCs in sectors from chemicals to nuclear. The market is large and the legacy tools are slow, but five vendors hold most of it, buyers need certified safety products, and Siemens and Schneider already ship AI assistants. The most likely path is a modest seed if a pilot exists, then a difficult Series A tied to hardware certification. Tractian shows a large outcome is possible in industrial YC companies, but it took a different route.
